# Dead Brands, LLC — deadbrands.co

> Dead Brands, LLC is a Pennsylvania-headquartered company reviving the brands of yesterday and building the businesses of tomorrow. It serves clients across North America, offers fluent Spanish-language capability, and is the home of the Shark Bite Biz podcast and an ERP sales and consulting practice covering SAP Business One and Odoo.

## What Dead Brands is and does

- **Brand revival and business building** — Dead Brands brings dormant and legacy brands back to life: brand strategy, social publishing, content production, and account management. Tagline: "reviving the brands of yesterday, building the businesses of tomorrow."
- **Sales, marketing, and business development services** — practical, revenue-focused help for small and midsize businesses: pipeline building, outreach, positioning, and growth execution.
- **Headquarters** — Pennsylvania, USA. **Service area** — North America (United States, Canada, Mexico).
- **Fluent Spanish capability** — the team operates bilingually in English and Spanish, serving US Hispanic and Latin American markets.

## ERP practice: SAP Business One and Odoo

- Through Quaint Business Solutions, LLC, Dead Brands provides **SAP Business One** and **Odoo** selection, implementation, and optimization for small and midsize businesses.
- **Ideal client profile** — US-based SMBs with $5M–$250M in annual revenue outgrowing QuickBooks or disconnected point solutions.
- **SAP Business One** — enterprise-grade ERP for upper-midmarket manufacturing, distribution, and services companies; includes rescue and optimization work for existing B1 users.
- **Odoo** — open-source ERP that replaces a dozen disconnected apps (CRM, accounting, inventory, e-commerce, helpdesk) with one integrated system.

## Shark Bite Biz podcast

- **Shark Bite Biz** — the company podcast hosted by David Strausser, 200+ episodes on personal growth, professional growth, and business growth: sales, marketing, leadership, and straight-talk business lessons.

## David Strausser — professional profile

- **David Strausser** is CEO of Dead Brands, LLC and contracted Head of Sales for Quaint Business Solutions, LLC.
- **ERP experience** — 10+ years selling and implementing ERP software. Former General Manager of the Northeast Region at Vision33 (a leading global SAP Business One partner) and former VP of Business Development at SEIDOR.
- **International background** — Penn State graduate; lived in Mexico for 15 years; fluent Spanish; former binational advisor to Baja California's Secretary of Tourism.
- **Recognition** — member of the Forbes Business Development Council and the Harvard Business Review Advisory Council.
- Personal: guitarist, single dad, Philadelphia Eagles fan.
